newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends lower, barley hits new lows.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends lower, barley hits new lows.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on commission selling and barley set new lows across the board on commercial seling, traders said.

"Commission houses and locals sold. There was commercial support in the Jan at $386," a trader said. Louis Dreyfus bought 200 Nov-Jan at $5.50, while 800 Jan-Mar $2 traded, traders said. November futures crush margin rose to -24.10 from -27.60 Monday. Volume was 4,400 lots with 200 hedges.
Japan bought 4,000-5,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
November canola lost $2.50 to $381, January lost $2 to $386.10. November flax rose $0.50 to $355.50 on U.S. demand.

November western barley fell $2.90 to $133.10, February lost $2.20 to $138.10 as Alberta Wheat Pool sold and UGG covered shorts, traders said. Feb-Mar spread at $0.50. All months set new lows. Volume was 1,450 lots.
December feed wheat fell $1.50 to $162.50, XCan sold March down $2 to $161.80 as UGG bought, traders said. Mar-July spread at $0.50, July-Dec at $1, Mar May at $0.50.
RBCDS sold 25 December peas unchanged at US$196. Cargill sold 70 December oats down US$1.50 to US$119.50 to Louis Dreyfus, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
